obligations.behavior: Qualify 6-beat descriptor capture with rvalid && rready, drain non-OKAY RRESP bursts to rlast before discarding, and size descriptor ID FIFO for >= 16 queued descriptors.
Accept and discard pre-sync AXI4-Stream beats without gating s_axis_ready on sync, and terminate/rewind cleanly on early s_axis_last across clock domains.
Preserve 32->64 final-beat byte strobes, recover cleanly after mid-burst warm reset, and meet WNS >= 0 ns across Slow (1.35x) and Fast (0.72x) Nangate45 OpenSTA.
